func (r *Reconciler) Run(ctx context.Context, periods []string) error {
	for _, period := range periods {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return ctx.Err()
		default:
		}
		batches, err := r.ledger.Batches(ctx, period)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("reconcile %s: load batches: %w", period, err)
		}
		for _, batch := range batches {
			if batch.Currency != r.currency {
				continue
			}
			if len(batch.Entries) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			var total int64
			for _, entry := range batch.Entries {
				switch {
				case entry.Reversed:
					continue
				case entry.Amount < 0:
					total -= -entry.Amount
				default:
					total += entry.Amount
				}
			}
			if batch.Rate == 0 {
				r.failures = append(r.failures, failure{
					Period: period,
					Batch:  batch.ID,
					Reason: "rate was zero",
				})
				continue
			}
			row := Row{
				Batch:      batch.ID,
				Opened:     batch.OpenedAt,
				Entries:    len(batch.Entries),
				TotalMinor: total,
				Net:        float64(total) / batch.Rate,
			}
			if batch.ClosedAt != nil {
				row.Closed = *batch.ClosedAt
			}
			if err := r.sink.Write(ctx, row); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("reconcile %s: write row %s: %w",
					period, batch.ID, err)
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

# Makefile fragment: recipes are tab-indented by definition.
build:
	go build -trimpath -o build/router ./cmd/router

test:
	go test ./... -count=1
	go vet ./...

release: build test
	tar --create --zstd --file build/router.tar.zst build/router
	shasum -a 256 build/router.tar.zst > build/router.tar.zst.sha256
